text:
Lia: Heads-up — discovered ~120 Vault KV v2 secrets with tag owner:external-account, and those secrets are mounted into a staging pod that uses a partner SA. Notably, RBAC allowed read by a cross-account role.
Sam: Can you paste the path pattern?
Lia: paths look like secret/data/infra/partner/* and secret/data/app/staging/partner-*. Some have kms_wrapped=true metadata.
Mike: Yikes. Any evidence of exfil? Audit shows read events from external-account-1@partner at 2028-06-07T14:22Z.
Lia: paste of relevant audit line: `time=2028-06-07T14:22Z method=read path=secret/data/infra/partner/foo latency=12ms principal=external:svc-partner-prod`.
security-bot: alert: vault.access.unusual - rate=3/day for principal external:svc-partner-prod — flagged for review.
Eva: Steps: 1) revoke mounted SA tokens, 2) prune tag ownership, 3) rotate affected secrets + rewrap KMS blobs, 4) audit export for compliance. I'll start a PR for the owner-tag cleanup script.
Sam: Can we do partial rotation without downtime? Some secrets are used by live staging traffic.
Mike: Yes — create ephemeral aliases and stagger toggles. We can add a feature-flagged creds switch in staging to flip service to new secret before revoke.
Lia: I'll run a discovery query: `vault kv list -format=json secret/infra/partner | jq '.[]'` and then `vault kv get -format=json secret/data/...` to gather metadata.
Eva: For KMS: if a ciphertext is rewrapped we need to call KMS.rewrap with new kek_id. Ops-oncall, can you queue rewrap window on the oncall calendar? Prefer 0300-0400 UTC.
ops-oncall: queued for 0300 UTC. I'll also create a temporary deny policy: `path "secret/data/infra/partner/*" { capabilities = ["deny"] }` and attach to external account until rotate completes.
Sam: I'll own the ticket to rotate secrets (INC-30999). Plan to rotate in groups of 25, run smoke tests, then revoke old versions.
Lia: Also recommend we export an audit bundle for legal: `vault audit-export -path secret/infra/partner -since 2028-06-01 > /tmp/partner-audit.json`.
Mike: After rotation, we'll run `gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete` for any leaked SA keys and check Cloud KMS key access logs.
Eva: I'll open a confluence runbook update for tag hygiene and add a CI lint that fails if owner tag is `external` in internal paths.
Lia: TL;DR: immediate deny policy attached, tokens revoked, discovery script running, rotation ticket created, rewrap window scheduled. Will post status updates here. :thumbsup:
Sam: Thanks — ping me when first 25 rotated.
security-bot: incident-assignee: Sam assigned to INC-30999
Lia: Update 2028-06-07T16:48Z — discovery script found 123 secrets, 86 flagged kms_wrapped=true. Starting group 1 now.
Sam: Group 1 done, smoke tests pass.
Lia: Group 2 started.
ops-oncall: Reminders sent to oncall rotation participants. Rewrap job started.
Eva: Filing postmortem checklist item: add automated alert for cross-account reads on internal secret paths.
Sam: Will draft communication to partner legal if we confirm any cross-account data pull beyond allowed scope.
Lia: Will follow up with final rotation audit JSON when finished.
